summary: String entity IDs produced NaN procedural phases; used entity animation phase instead.
Partner rendering assumed one-based seats; fixed zero-based identity/accessory distinction.
Actual hyphenated simulation events did not trigger most custom SFX/voices; mapped real events.
Help stated2500 while game announced1000 exit bounty; made1000 consistent.
Continue restored state without room-entry checkpoint; load full save envelope for correct retry.
Keyboard partner aim keys missing from input map; explicit per-seat bindings now installed.
Corrupt persisted simulation could reach renderer; validate version/room/entity arrays/tuning at storage boundary.
Authored scheduled spawn could resolve on a blocking bell post; validate and relocate schedules.
Actor AI route refreshed per frame could overshoot a junction and familiar escape path loop; choose direction at each grid junction.
Online mouse aim used the first warden position for every client; resolve bearing from the local assigned seat.
Developer single-step advanced the world without marking Practice; explicitly invalidate ranked scoring.
A synthetic touch click after attract wake could activate the newly exposed title menu; consume the full waking gesture and its click.
Landscape logical resolution made portrait phone radar/status text too small; use native portrait resolution override and a readable portrait instrument layout.
Native pointer movement preserved keyboard prompt ownership, delaying mouse aim until click; deliberate movement now updates the device before the visible muzzle selects its lane.
High-contrast and stronger radar settings were stored but not drawn/sounded; connect them to radar contrast, hidden-blip emphasis and faster/louder warning pulses.
